# Set Up 
This page provides a sample Eligibility Report generated using `gsm.kri` package, with the optional pilot data simulated on top of the basic example: open EDC queries and active EDC PDs (level 1), the records behind each flag (level 2) and the `Analysis_elig0001` risk metric history (level 3). These add a Potentially Ineligible status, the records behind each flag in the listing's expanded rows and CSV, and Status over Time; see the data contract in `?Report_Eligibility`. Switch to **Basic** to see the same participants without the pilot data. Expand the "Setup" section below to see the code used to generate the report. Or scroll down for the standard report output.

<details>
<summary>Setup</summary>

```{r}
# Load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(gsm.core)
library(gsm.kri)
library(gsm.mapping)

# Prepare example data

dfResults <- gsm.core::reportingResults_study %>%
  filter(MetricID %in% "Analysis_qtl0001")

dfMetrics <- gsm.core::reportingMetrics_study %>%
  filter(MetricID %in% "Analysis_qtl0001")

# Site-level groups fill the listing's Investigator Name.
dfGroups <- gsm.core::reportingGroups

mappings_wf <- workr::MakeWorkflowList(
  strNames = c("IE", "EXCLUSION", "ENROLL", "PD"),
  strPath = "workflow/1_mappings",
  strPackage = "gsm.mapping"
)

mappings_spec <- gsm.mapping::CombineSpecs(mappings_wf)

lRaw <- map_depth(
  list(gsm.core::lSource),
  1,
  gsm.mapping::Ingest,
  mappings_spec
)

mapped <- map_depth(lRaw, 1, ~ workr::RunWorkflows(mappings_wf, .x))

dfExclusion <- mapped[[1]]$Mapped_EXCLUSION

# Simulate the pilot data. Level 1: every 9th participant has an open I/E
# query and every 23rd an active EDC PD; PDs split by importance.
idx <- seq_len(nrow(dfExclusion))
dfPilot <- dfExclusion %>%
  mutate(
    pd_important = ifelse(!is.na(eligibility_criteria) & idx %% 2 == 0, "Y", "N"),
    pd_nonimportant = ifelse(!is.na(eligibility_criteria) & idx %% 2 == 1, "Y", "N"),
    edc_query = ifelse(idx %% 9 == 0, "Y", "N"),
    edc_pd = ifelse(idx %% 23 == 0, "Y", "N")
  )

# Level 2: the records behind each flag, one row per record.
dfRecords <- bind_rows(
  dfPilot %>%
    filter(ie_violation == "Y") %>%
    tidyr::separate_longer_delim(ietestcd_concat, delim = ",") %>%
    transmute(
      studyid, subjid, source = "EDC eCRF", record_id = paste0("IE-", row_number()),
      record_date = NA_character_, Form = "Inclusion/Exclusion Criteria",
      Response = paste0(ietestcd_concat, ": ", ifelse(grepl("^incl", ietestcd_concat), "No", "Yes"))
    ),
  dfPilot %>%
    filter(edc_query == "Y") %>%
    transmute(
      studyid, subjid, source = "EDC Query", record_id = paste0("Q", row_number()),
      record_date = "2025-05-20", Folder = "ENROLL", Form = "Inclusion/Exclusion Criteria",
      QueryText = "Please confirm the participant meets inclusion criterion 4; source shows a value outside the protocol range.",
      MarkingGroupName = "CDA to Site Manual Query", Status = "Open"
    ),
  dfPilot %>%
    filter(edc_pd == "Y") %>%
    transmute(
      studyid, subjid, source = "EDC PD", record_id = paste0("D", row_number()),
      record_date = NA_character_, Folder = "SCRN", Form = "Protocol Deviation", Status = "Active"
    ),
  dfPilot %>%
    filter(!is.na(eligibility_criteria)) %>%
    # Mapped_EXCLUSION joins a participant's PDs; level 2 has one row per PD.
    tidyr::separate_longer_delim(c(dvdtm, eligibility_criteria), delim = ";;;") %>%
    transmute(
      studyid, subjid, source = "Protocol Deviation", record_id = paste0("PD-", row_number()),
      record_date = substr(dvdtm, 1, 10), Description = eligibility_criteria,
      Classification = ifelse(pd_important == "Y", "Important", "Non-important")
    )
)

# Level 3: the risk metric from the third snapshot on, with a Potentially
# Ineligible share of about a tenth of enrolled.
dfRisk <- dfResults %>%
  arrange(SnapshotDate) %>%
  slice(-(1:2)) %>%
  mutate(
    MetricID = "Analysis_elig0001",
    Numerator = Numerator + round(Denominator / 10),
    Metric = Numerator / Denominator
  )
dfResults <- bind_rows(dfResults, dfRisk)

lListings <- list(
  IE_num = dfPilot %>% filter(Source != "Neither"),
  IE_denom = dfPilot,
  IE_records = dfRecords
)
```

</details>

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
## Render example report inline using knit_child
child_env <- list2env(
  list(
    params = list(
      dfResults = dfResults,
      dfMetrics = dfMetrics,
      dfGroups = dfGroups,
      lListings = lListings
    )
  ),
  parent = environment()
)
report_eligibility <- knitr::knit_child(
  system.file("report", "Report_Eligibility.Rmd", package = "gsm.kri"),
  envir = child_env,
  quiet = TRUE
)
cat(report_eligibility, sep = "\n")
```
